takeaways: The best unused Sylvan material here is the Oakview Backyard project (B&A-Oakview folder). Pair before 55 with after 9 in a before/after slider on work/sylvan-gardens, and use cell 9 or the Lighting folder's twilight fire-pit shot (cell 7) as the Sylvan cover. The Lighting set (cells 7, 12, 13 and 5) makes a strong 'day to night' gallery for the case study. The unused Crew Pics frames (8 backlit mower, 20 smiling raker, 15 trailer logo) add people to the case study and service:content-development. Seasonal standouts suit blog:organic-social-growth-landscaping: monarch on Joe-Pye weed (Perennials 2024 #63), tulip bed (Annuals #63) and spring daffodils (Pictures/Perennials #30). Almost everything else is client phone documentation, heavily duplicated between the Pictures/ and PHOTOS REPOSITORY-2024/ trees. There is no hero-loop footage in this chunk, and the media release form (PII) must stay off the site.
